correctness.rationale: Two exact half-circle solutions yield P=f^2 and polynomial degree bound n^(2k). For Chebyshev reset, every one of n monotone laps crosses [0,1] with strict margins; length-m inverse-branch words produce n^m disjoint fixed points, exhausting the degree-n^m polynomial f^m-u and proving all roots simple. For each periodic section point, positive intermediate heights make the hybrid itinerary valid. Root simplicity at k and 2k excludes multipliers +1 and -1. Simple critical points and strict value margins persist under small coefficient perturbations. Exact-arithmetic Sturm counts for (n,k)=(2,1),(2,2),(3,1) verify finite instances but are not relied on for the infinite proof.
